save.text: Episode: Critical Role live show with guest Patrick Rothfuss (via Skype).
Sam absent; Scanlan role shared by Keyleth and Percy, Pike absent in New York.
Announcements: Lootcrate sponsorship (January theme 'origins'); promo code 'criticalrole' for 10% off; order cutoff 9PM tonight; URL lootcrate.com/criticalrole.
Blue Microphones provided new audio equipment; bluemic.com mentioned.

Recap: Vox Machina defeated Thordak, Raishan stole Thordak's corpse and two eggs, fled to southern island (former Thordak/Opash lair); Kerrek joined group to aid search for Raishan. (confirmed by Matt).
Characters leveled: Scanlan, Percy, Pike (announced by Matt).
Pike offered access to full cleric spell list for new level; party joked about taking Power Word Kill (Laura/Liam/Marisha).
Attunement rule: if Belt of Dwarvenkind is attuned, hammer can also be attuned; if belt unattuned, hammer must be unattuned (Matt).
Boots of Elvenkind found; do not require attunement (Matt); Pike can wear them but Sprinter's Boots will be replaced while worn (Matt).
Dwarven Thrower chosen by Grog/Travis to attune to; Blood Axe will be relinquished (Travis/Matt).
Grog pulled scimitar; blade cursed and expended, leaving Grog permanently at -2 to all saving throws until a god removes it (Matt).
Pike (Laura) will attempt Greater Restoration (5th-level) to remove curse/effect; uncertainty if it will work (Laura/Matt).
Keyleth (Marisha) offered Grog her Ring of Protection +2 (gives +2 AC and +2 to all saves); Grog declined due to attunement requirement (Marisha/Travis).
Pike used 5th-level Greater Restoration on Grog but it failed to remove his headache/curse (Matt).
Taliesin's Ring of Lightning Resistance card is missing; Taliesin noticed (Taliesin).
Party prepared Heroes' Feast (6th-level cast by Pike); benefits: immunity to poison and fear, +15 max HP each (rolled 15), feeds up to 12 including NPCs Kerr, Allura, Kima, Trinket (Matt/Laura).

Players debating approach to Opash's cave: avoid scrying to preserve surprise; Marisha can Transport Via Plants to teleport party there; Matt: scrying creates visible magical orb detectable by creatures with see invisibility (turns 316-324,322).
Kima and Allura arrive and join Heroes' Feast; Kima fully armored, takes Gate Stone to give to Cassandra for safekeeping (turns 359,373,387).

Party found several quartz-like 'salt lick' rocks along road/castle garden; Grog keeps one palm-sized and larger center one basketball-sized; marked three quartz rocks and stored in Bag of Holding (turns 342,351,353,354).
Kima takes Elven Boots but initially says 'not my style' then changes and dons them; Allura gives boots to Kima for stealth (Laura/Matt).
Party teleports via Sun Tree to island near mountain/lab; Pass Without Trace cast on party beforehand (Marisha/Laura/Matt).
Landscape on arrival: lush jungle edges, trees blackened nearer the mountain in a radial pattern; quarter-mile to visible mountain summit (Matt).
Kima takes Elven Boots, initially hesitant then dons them for stealth (Laura/Matt).
Arrival landscape: lush jungle edge; trees blackened/petrified in radial pattern around mountain; damage centuries-old with no recent scarring (Matt/Marisha).
Party has Pass Without Trace active (+10 stealth); multiple high stealth rolls: Allura nat20, Keyleth nat20, Pike 24, Scanlan 31, Taliesin 33, Grog 13 (with +10), Kerr effectively 24 (Patrick).
Mountain area has 'hollow earth' magical sinkhole patches—unstable ground ovals (~10–15 ft) that grow denser nearer mountain; observed and identified (Matt).
Vax detected a subtly different patch of ground just ahead (Investigation 18) after Vex alerted him; Vex had 26 and flagged it (Laura/Liam/Matt).
Party warned to avoid dark patch areas; Grog tested by tossing rock which fell through—confirming ground gives way (Travis/Matt).

Mountain approach: 600-ft mound; one boulder (20–30 ft) jammed in entrance ~200 ft from landing with clustered claw-pierced holes sized like very large dragon claws; boulder has been placed/removed repeatedly over years (Matt).
Landscape: lush jungle edge; trees blackened/petrified in radial pattern around mountain; closer approach increases deadening (Matt/Marisha).

Party plans: consider creating an entrance by Stone Shape at seam of boulder (Marisha) vs checking for other entrances (would require ~1.5–2 hr flight around mountain) — group leaning to shape boulder and potentially scry first (Marisha/Laura/Travis/Matt).
Divine Sense/Primeval Awareness: Patrick detected three dragon life forces roughly toward mountain/below within 60 ft (Patrick/Matt).
Vex/Misc: Party decides to enter mountain now; detection confirms dragons within one mile (Laura/Marisha/Matt).
Grog found a 'Parapet of Wound Closure' (non-attunement) and agreed to trade it to Vex but promised not to use/look at other items from the deck; pouch exchange performed (Travis/Laura/Matt).
Vex traded Parapet of Wound Closure to Vex and recovered her deck of cards; Grog promised not to look at them while Vex held them (Travis/Laura/Matt).

Marisha used Stone Shape (4th-level) to create ~5-ft passage into tunnel; opening allows arm reach and view ~100 ft to a left-curving, descending tunnel with heavy undisturbed dust, no light or movement (Marisha/Matt/Laura).
Oracle Arrow (Laura) shot into tunnel; landed ~100 ft in, confirming darkness, dust, no tracks, silent—potential for echoing noise if disturbed (Laura/Matt).
Marisha considered using Druidcraft to grow plants to crack the boulder but concluded it would take ~1000 years (Marisha).
Stone Shape already used once; another cast could carve a narrow finger-width channel to free the boulder (Patrick/Matt).

Options discussed to bypass boulder: Grog leverage/punch (noisy), use siege gauntlets, use Oil of Etherealness on Scanlan or Pike to go through rock, or insert Kima's sword as a lever (Travis/Liam/Marisha/Taliesin/Matt).

Group used sword-as-lever with Pike aiding Grog (advantage) to shift boulder ~1.5 ft; party pushed through tunnel (rolls: Grog 23; others mixed; Trinket 19). Immovable Rods jammed into finger-holes to hold boulder (each rod holds 8,000 lb); rods are wedged but slowly moving (turns 898-921, 925).
Party entered 15-ft-wide, ~12-ft-tall tunnel with stale, rot/wet-earth smell; no airflow; floor dust present; they left boulder wedged (turns 932-933, 925).
Vax/party observed scattered bone shards on tunnel floor, some charred/blackened; pieces range pebble-sized to slightly larger (turns 942-947).

Vax/party observed scattered bone shards on tunnel floor, some charred/blackened; pieces range pebble-sized to slightly larger; nature check (Marisha) 28 => charring is years old at least; dust layer indicates untouched for a short time (turns 942-982).
Pike cast Death Ward (4th-level) on Vex; effect lasts 8 hours (cast by Pike/Laura; confirmed by Matt) (turns 998-1000).
Party rerolled stealth in tunnel; group stealth results: Laura 30, Liam 35, Taliesin 34, Marisha 30, Travis 30, Scanlan 18, Pike 25, Patrick 29 (turns 965-976).
While moving stealthily in tunnel, Kerrek/Grog put arm around others; Vax's dagger emits flame acting as candle illuminating ~15 ft; Vax can see 60 ft with dagger lit (Matt).

Tunnel has alcoves/shelves every ~20 ft containing melted candles, skull, small books, wooden box (box checked by Vax, Investigation 22, not trapped), and a mummified raccoon specimen (turns 1054-1096).

Investigation/Perception checks: Vax perception 29 (turn 1059?) then 22 and 22 for investigation/trap check; general progress: incremental checks while moving; dim light/darkvision mechanics clarified (Matt).
Tunnel shelf contains two melted candles and a human skull; skull bone is slightly singed/blackened (observed by Kerrek/Grog; Matt).
Divine Sense located an undead presence to the left in a wall area; type/direction known (Kerrek/Patrick; Matt).
Boots of Elvenkind found; do not require attunement (Matt); Kima took/donned Elven Boots for stealth (Laura/Matt).
Divine Sense confirmed skull is source of undead energy but inert while held; Kerr/Patrick held it and then bagged it facing wall (Patrick/Matt).

Hexagonal chamber: central dark green marble pillar with iron bowl atop (~5-6 ft high on 10 ft pillar), 25 ft ceiling; off to right: large leather tome and unburnt cold iron brazier with tinder (Matt).

Divine Sense & Perception in chamber: no undead sensed within 60 ft; multiple party members rolled high Perception (Vax 26, Vax 22, others 16,15 etc.) confirming chamber clear (Liam/Marisha/Travis/Matt).
Room layout: entering chamber -> opposite larger door blocks progress. Between: raised platform, pillar with iron bowl, brazier & shelf with single tome on right wall (Matt).
No visible ceiling mechanisms or wall levers/panels; stone masonry with some cave-ins—no mechanical connections seen (Matt).
Iron bowl contains long-dried residue: scraped to a dark burgundy powder tasting of iron—identified as blood (Laura/Matt).
Lighting: Keyleth cast Fire Hands to illuminate room (Marisha/Matt).
Tome: large leather tome on shelf, no text on cover/spine; uncertain material (tanned hide vs flesh) due to light (Matt).
Book on shelf reacts to light: text shrinks/obscures as observers focus; bright radiant light (Kerr's hammer) makes pages go nearly blank; in low light smaller text persists (observed by multiple).
No holes in ceiling; brazier present with tinder/dried material inside (Matt).
Party considered placing vial/blood in iron bowl; vials of dragon blood and other bloods available (Laura/Taliesin).

Book on shelf reacts to light: text shrinks/obscures as observers focus; bright radiant light (Kerr's hammer) makes pages go nearly blank; in low light smaller text persists (observed by multiple). Book was later destroyed in brazier explosion (Matt).
Brazier contains highly explosive, extremely flammable liquids mixed with kindling; lighting it caused an explosion that bent metal and destroyed the book (Matt).
Group attempted pouring dragon/basilisk/white dragon blood into iron bowl; initial basilisk vial poured and pooled with no immediate effect; Vex cut her hand to drip her blood next (Laura/Matt).

Basilisk blood in bowl reacts: blood poured pools; additional drops (Vex's bleeding) drawn beneath basilisk blood surface; small blood drops can trigger mechanism. After adding blood the bowl glows, basilisk blood sizzles and recedes to edges; door lifts revealing other side. Party took 1 point damage from the blood exposure. (Observed by Matt during turn 1451–1470).

Floating flame-wreathed skulls (about four) summoned/activated in hallway after door opened; approach from both sides, cackling; likely necromantic/trapped (one may have been in a bag previously). Pike cast Holy Aura creating 30-ft radius radiant protective runes when skulls approached. Initiative rolled immediately after. (Observed by Matt during turns 1472–1490,1491–1499).

Book on shelf reacts to light: text shrinks/obscures as observers focus; bright radiant light (Kerr's hammer) makes pages go nearly blank; in low light smaller text persists (observed by multiple). Book was later destroyed in brazier explosion (Matt).
Scanlan cast Invisibility (2nd-level) on himself and moved to northern wall corner, then held position (Taliesin/Matt).
Vax flew ~10 ft in the air to opposite wall and threw two daggers: hits dealing 19 and 10 damage; daggers' flames caused skulls to duck and take cracking damage (Liam/Matt).
Keyleth cast Moonbeam (concentration) centered to affect two skulls; both failed CON saves and each took 13 radiant damage; flames on damaged skulls subsided briefly (Marisha/Matt).
Flame skulls fired four red beams -> four simultaneous Fireballs hitting party; all but Scanlan made 4 Dex saves with advantage (Matt).

Individual results: Marisha, Taliesin, Liam saved all; Percy took 56 fire; Keyleth saved all and is at 50 HP; Grog failed two -> took 88 (then Matt corrected to 72 earlier) resulting in 48? (conflicting) Matt ultimately assigned Grog 72 then 70/88 confusion; Matt later said Grog took 72 then 48? (damage bookkeeping messy).
Pike failed two saves -> would be 88 fire but halved by fire resistance to 44; Trinket saved once and is safe in necklace; Scanlan not affected (absent).
Taliesin (Percy) killed two flame skulls with Animus shots; used and regained grit points (confirmed by Matt).
Aura of Divinity (Patrick) grants +3 to saving throws for allies nearby; would have changed several fire save outcomes (Patrick/Matt).
Matt retroactively applied +3 to saves: this would have reduced damage for some characters (Pike gained 11 HP back from halved fire calculation per Matt).
